title: xkcd | Randall Munroe | Talks at Google
summary: Randall Munroe, creator of xkcd, gives an Authors@Google talk in 2007 about the webcomic and his background, followed by audience Q&A. Donald Knuth and Guido van Rossum ask questions during the session.
why: HN refers to it for the moment where Knuth asks a question and addresses the Steve Jobs anecdote, a favorite geek moment.

quote.text: one of the all-time great geek moments was when Munroe did a tech talk at Google
